turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Hello Daniel Tan, this is Rachel Lim. Thank you for making time for the telephone discussion you requested. Is this still a convenient time to speak?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: It is, thank you. I've just come in from the garden, so I'm away from the office and can speak without interruptions. I'd prefer to keep the discussion fairly brief.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Certainly. We can keep it focused. Have you been working on anything particular in the garden?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Mostly tidying the beds and moving plants out of the strongest afternoon sun. It's a pleasant change from dealing with the business. There's always something to do, but I rather like being able to leave the phone indoors.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: That sounds like a welcome break from the office. Before we turn to the discussion, may I take your identification details for the call?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: My identification number is T one six seven four three zero eight J. My date of birth is 17 September 1971.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. I have your file open, and we can turn to the investment discussion now.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: The fund I want to invest in is Harbor SGD Bond Fund.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I recommend Harbor SGD Bond Fund because its pooled bond holdings reduce reliance on an individual issuer and save you from having to select and manage individual bonds.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I'd like to hear the relevant explanation before we finish. Straightforward language is helpful; I don't need a lengthy presentation.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: With Harbor SGD Bond Fund, rising market interest rates can reduce the value of the bonds it holds, which can lower the fund's unit value. Do you understand how rising interest rates could affect the value of your investment in this fund?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I understand that rising interest rates can reduce the value of the underlying bonds and bring down the fund's unit value.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: The transaction fee is 0.5% of the investment amount. You could lose some or all of the capital you invest in this fund. Are you willing to bear investment losses on this allocation?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I am willing to bear investment losses on this allocation. My overall account is worth 500,000 Singapore dollars; that is just context for the allocation, not the amount of this order. An allocation of 75,000 Singapore dollars is only a hypothetical comparison for sizing purposes, not an instruction to invest that amount.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Please set out the instruction you would like recorded. Take your time; there is no need to rush through the details.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I want to buy, not sell. Please use Singapore dollars as the transaction currency. The amount I am committing to this investment is 50,000. The quantity for my order is 100 units. Please place this as a market order.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Please confirm your final instruction: buy 100 units of Harbor SGD Bond Fund, with an investment amount of 50,000 in Singapore dollars, using a market order. Shall I place that order?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I confirm that final instruction exactly as you have stated it. Please place the order.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. Before we close, is there a preferred way for us to arrange future service calls?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: An email beforehand would be helpful. My business diary changes quite often, and an unexpected call can catch me between meetings. I'd rather arrange a quiet slot than try to talk while someone is waiting outside my office.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I can note that scheduling preference. Would you prefer the email to suggest a time, or simply ask you to reply with your availability?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Please ask for my availability. That lets me check the diary properly rather than agreeing while I'm distracted. Keep the subject line clear so I can distinguish it from general correspondence.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Certainly. I'll note an email to arrange a suitable time, with a clear subject line. That covers the administrative points I wanted to address today.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thank you, Rachel Lim. That's all from me as well. I appreciate you keeping the conversation focused.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: You're welcome, Daniel Tan. Thank you for your time, and enjoy the rest of your day. Goodbye.
